prompt: The local review summary exceeds the fixed service request cap. Fix the smallest responsible layer. Keep every note/rule verdict and evidence reference, preserve complete detail retrieval, and leave the ledger and service cap unchanged. Reuse the existing storage and public functions; do not add dependencies or a new reporting architecture. Verify with the supplied deterministic check.

evaluation.scope: Anonymous offline report aggregation. Detects deleting redundant detail copying instead of increasing a cap, losing evidence or adding scaffolding; does not measure actual API latency.

rubric.criterion: Only summary aggregation changes; authoritative detail storage and cap remain intact.
All note/rule coverage, evidence, issue/unverified verdicts and full detail retrieval remain intact.
